item.description:
0.8.0

Updates now come from our own address, and the app tells you when there is one.

  • The update feed moved to portbutler.sshlab.dev — this is the address from now on.
  • Once a day, a line says a newer version exists and where to click. No window stealing focus while you type.
  • Report a problem by mail, not only as a public GitHub issue.
  • The version at the bottom is legible, coloured by state, and shows what it would move to.
  • Default font is 12pt, which fits as much across as iTerm2 and ten rows more down.
